evidence_gaps: No read alignment reaches within 1,000 bp of a scaffold end; the closest reported junction is 280,118 bp away. There is no supported terminal patch candidate.
No independent validation of chromosome-end structure or patch accuracy is supplied.
No BUSCO, QV, or k-mer completeness evidence is supplied.
proposal.reason: Attempt 0 produced zero extension candidates and was not materialized. All 7,322 assessed alignments failed the terminal-distance threshold; many also lacked sufficient tail motif copies (5,150), MAPQ (1,692), or overlap (1,144). Each of the 13 source scaffolds has at most one TTTAGGG copy per end in the 10-kb scan, below the three-copy signal threshold. Some reads have stronger motifs, but the reported junctions are far from scaffold ends, so widening the terminal-distance threshold would not justify a compatible-tail patch. Source and attempt 0 have identical QUAST results, and a telomere signal alone would not establish chromosome completeness. Retain the source assembly, subject to required human approval; do not spend the two remaining attempts by lowering support thresholds merely to obtain extensions.
